extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: wicker picnic basket, approx. 44 x 30 x 36 cm incl. handle
extras.notes: front faces -Y; woven wicker bands around stakes, wrapped rim, fixed honey-wood handle over the middle, two wooden lids hinged on the centre line: 'picnic-basket_lid_front' (rotate around local X, negative angle opens) and 'picnic-basket_lid_back' (positive angle opens), up to about 75 degrees; red-and-white gingham cloth hanging over the front rim; no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
